# kanithanj.ai (full)

This page matches a short self-description to public software and engineering roles in your browser. Nothing you type leaves the page. This page never applies or sends on your behalf. A person must confirm, then open the posting themselves.

On the first find_roles call, pass stateVersion 0. After that, pass the stateVersion last returned. A stale stateVersion is refused with StaleWrite and the current version. While a person-confirm step is open, other tools return an error until it is answered. tailor_cv and show_apply_pack only accept an id already shown on the page.

## Regions and filters

regions is an optional array of: SE Sweden, EU (includes Sweden), UK United Kingdom, US United States, CA Canada, LATAM Latin America, APAC Asia-Pacific, MEA Middle East and Africa. If no region is picked, every place counts as a fit.

remote is one of: any, remote, hybrid, onsite. productOnly is a boolean that hides roles that look like agency or freelance work.

## Page tools

### find_roles (Find roles)

Fill the page form with a self-description and show matching roles in this browser. If a change matches nothing, the roles already shown stay. When few roles match, or a change matches nothing, gap names the missing sources and what to add. Nothing leaves the page. Does not apply or send.

Input schema:
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "stateVersion"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "stateVersion": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Pass 0 on the first call, then the stateVersion from the last answer."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "goal": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "regions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "SE",
          "EU",
          "UK",
          "US",
          "CA",
          "LATAM",
          "APAC",
          "MEA"
        ]
      }
    },
    "remote": {
      "enum": [
        "any",
        "remote",
        "hybrid",
        "onsite"
      ]
    },
    "productOnly": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}

### show_apply_pack (Show apply pack)

Show a local apply pack for a role already on the page: public facts, the posting link, and a checklist. This page never applies or sends on your behalf. A person must confirm, then open the posting themselves.

Input schema:
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Id of a role already shown on the page"
    },
    "apply": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "If true, a person must confirm in the page. The page still does not apply."
    },
    "send": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "If true, a person must confirm in the page. The page still does not send."
    }
  }
}

### tailor_cv (Tailor CV)

Show a local outline of what to emphasize for a role already on the page, built from the text in the form and public posting facts. Nothing is sent. This is not a submitted CV.

Input schema:
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Id of a role already shown on the page"
    }
  }
}

## How to use them

1. Call find_roles with stateVersion 0 and a description. Skip name, email and phone; they are not needed.
2. Pick an id from the result and call tailor_cv or show_apply_pack.
3. If apply or send is set on show_apply_pack, a person must confirm in the page, then open the posting themselves.
